title: Mimesis, Poiesis, and Imagination: Exploring Text-to-Image Generation of Biblical Narratives

bias_targets.methodology: Comparative visual analysis of Midjourney outputs, Google search results, and classical paintings to evaluate the representation of race, skin tone, and cultural settings, specifically assessing whether the AI defaults to Eurocentric artistic traditions or demonstrates diversity when prompted with non-Western perspectives.

Qualitative visual inspection of generated images to identify the unwarranted insertion of male figures into a traditionally all-female biblical narrative (the finding of Moses), evaluating how this reflects systemic minimization of female agency and reinforces male oversight in visual culture.
